Universal macOS app for Apple Silicon and Intel. Requires macOS 13 or later.

Open the DMG and drag Walkingpad Companion to Applications, or extract the ZIP. Allow Bluetooth access on first launch.

This automated build is ad-hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. After attempting to open the app, macOS may require approval in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

Download `SHA256SUMS` alongside the archives and run `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` to check their integrity.
